lessons.key: ac_gap::when an ac names several read paths implement and test every one of them a single record read does not satisfy a criterion written about a list endpoint
lessons.text: When an AC names several read paths, implement and test every one of them - a single-record read does not satisfy a criterion written about a list endpoint.

lessons.key: ac_gap::every middleware wired into a route needs its own integration test wiring it is not evidence that it behaves
lessons.text: Every middleware wired into a route needs its own integration test - wiring it is not evidence that it behaves.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::specify the http status code for every named error state not just the state name or the tests silently become the contract
lessons.text: Specify the HTTP status code for every named error state, not just the state name, or the tests silently become the contract.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a test mocks the query runner assert the sql string s joins and column aliases too hand fed rows prove the mapper never the query
lessons.text: When a test mocks the query runner, assert the SQL string's joins and column aliases too - hand-fed rows prove the mapper, never the query.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a cli script carries a guard that protects real data extract it as a pure function and unit test it scoping the scripts layer to argument parsing in the coverage matrix silently leaves that guard untested
lessons.text: When a CLI script carries a guard that protects real data, extract it as a pure function and unit-test it — scoping the scripts layer to 'argument parsing' in the coverage matrix silently leaves that guard untested.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::before writing integration tests against a table verify the target database s real constraints instead of trusting the versioned migration or the decision log dev here still had an fk both said was removed
lessons.text: Before writing integration tests against a table, verify the target database's real constraints instead of trusting the versioned migration or the decision log — dev here still had an FK both said was removed.
evidence: STATE.md 2026-08-07 FK decision vs dev schema (database)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::an ac whose outcome is console output cannot be verified by the test suite either assert the rendered string or record in the spec that the ac is manual only
lessons.text: An AC whose outcome is console output cannot be verified by the test suite; either assert the rendered string or record in the spec that the AC is manual-only.

lessons.key: ac_gap::quando uma ac de ui exige uma contagem ou um agregado extraia o calculo para uma funcao pura e teste a deixa lo dentro do componente o coloca na camada isenta de teste e a ac fica sem nenhuma assercao
lessons.text: Quando uma AC de UI exige uma contagem ou um agregado, extraia o cálculo para uma função pura e teste-a: deixá-lo dentro do componente o coloca na camada isenta de teste e a AC fica sem nenhuma asserção.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::isentar componentes react do teste deixa o gate cego a o indicador sumiu registre isso como risco declarado na spec porque build e lint passam com o render neutralizado
lessons.text: Isentar componentes React do teste deixa o gate cego a 'o indicador sumiu': registre isso como risco declarado na spec, porque build e lint passam com o render neutralizado.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::ac que manda exibir a data sem fixar o formato nao e verificavel defina o formato esperado na spec ou marque a ac como nao asserivel
lessons.text: AC que manda 'exibir a data' sem fixar o formato não é verificável: defina o formato esperado na spec ou marque a AC como não asserível.
